request.prompt:
Vertical 9:16, eight-second hand-painted animated shot. Match the attached
Ignite painted calculus scene: cream paper, visible soft brush grain, teal
curving track, warm ochre board, strong foreshortening and a clear diagonal
from lower left toward upper right. Use the attached original Sol reference
exactly: the same asymmetrical flame silhouette and layered orange/cream
colors, two dark oval eyes, tiny rounded limbs, and a completely mouthless
face. Sol is one character, not fire, smoke, a human or a new mascot design.

Open with the board beginning to roll and Sol immediately making one small
confident hop onto it. Anticipation, airborne pose, then a slightly awkward
landing. Use just three or four deliberate stepped character poses with a
short held landing; do not turn this into smooth rubbery interpolation.
The board keeps moving while Sol tries to look composed. Use a low three-
quarter tracking camera and preserve perspective and painted texture.
Leave the bottom fifth clear for captions added later. End with travel
continuing toward screen right and a short usable hold on Sol aboard.

No mouth, teeth, lips, talking, lip sync, extra eyes, fingers, long arms,
realistic flames, smoke, plastic 3D shaders, glossy CGI, morphing character,
duplicate Sol, text, subtitles, equations, graph axes, tangent graphics,
logos or watermarks. No generated audio.

Use the supplied startImage A as the exact opening composition and endImage B as the exact closing composition. Animate one continuous A to B shot: hop onto the moving board, land, and wobble exactly once to catch his balance. One tiny existing arm begins to extend as he settles into the low side angle. Timing: anticipate at 0-0.4 seconds, hop at 0.4-1.2 seconds, land both feet by 1.8 seconds, wobble once at 1.8-2.8 seconds, and reach the B composition by 3 seconds. Hold that composition through the remaining clip, with gentle board motion, so the existing 3.6-second edit retains the full action. Preserve the painted Sol identity, compact flame shape, original eyes, stubby limbs, mouthless face, texture and palette in both frames. No cuts, dissolves, speech or music.
